criteria.requirement: Add Logger.handler_snapshot() returning an id-sorted tuple of immutable detached scalar mappings: id, sink_type (actual adapter class), level, formatter static/callable, filter none/callable, enqueue, serialize and stopped. Capture under the existing core lock for consistent concurrent add/remove views. Never expose core/handler/sink/callback objects, call their business methods or repr, or mutate configuration while inspecting it. Old snapshots remain stable after removal. Keep existing repr/add/remove semantics and demonstrate multiple actual sink types and concurrent configuration reads.
